hooks.prompt:
If user asks to implement/build/create/add a feature:
1. Check if user story exists in .claude/project/features/
2. If no story: Create one first, add to high-level-user-stories.md
3. Check if plan exists in .claude/project/plans/
4. If no plan: Create one, get user approval before coding
5. Only start implementation after story + plan + approval

Suggest: "Let me first create a user story and plan for approval."

File naming conventions:
- Stories: .claude/project/features/us-XXX-short-name.md (lowercase)
- Plans: .claude/project/plans/us-XXX-plan.md (lowercase)
- Display: US-XXX (uppercase in tables/text)
Suggest correct location and naming if incorrect.

After creating story/plan in .claude/project/:
1. Update high-level-user-stories.md table
2. Update Overview counts
3. Link plan in story's Plan column

After editing high-level-user-stories.md or roadmap.md:
- Verify counts match statuses
- Ensure links valid
- Update phase progress

Before completing feature:
1. Update story status in high-level-user-stories.md
2. Add commit hash
3. Update roadmap.md phase progress
4. Review skills - remove unhelpful, suggest new ones
